name: Exterior Engineered Wood Siding RP Condition Assessment
intent: Fixed-time condition assessment: DSD rating, adhesion test, moisture test (engineered wood-specific — more moisture-sensitive), coating ID, lead evaluation.
doctrine: RP assessment for engineered wood. Same pattern as wood siding RP. MC testing is critical — engineered wood is more moisture-sensitive than natural wood or fiber cement. MC > 15% = stop work gate. Lead eval for pre-1978 only.
